title: Each 'exclude' appends one exclusion to the interaction's 'policy.exclude', its pairs and reason exactly as written.
why: behavioural spec 'exclude': appends { when: [ { dimension, point } ], reason } to 'policy.exclude' in call order, each pair in the order given and each reference as written, a short one and a full id alike, because resolving it is the engine's (ADR 0080 decision 3). 'policy' holds only 'exclude'. A chain that does not call 'exclude' writes no 'policy', which every other translation case's 'spec' pins.

interaction.description: an order that may have shipped

exclude.reason: the order service dates a shipped order
